claim: The demo loads four sample observations in a separate workspace
where: landing action note, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a real observation; enter /demo; assert four shipped samples and no real observation; add a demo observation and return home

claim: Works offline after your first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; open /demo once; go offline; reload; assert the four shipped observations remain visible

claim: Records stay in this browser unless you export them
sandbox: fresh browser context; write a real observation; open /demo; add a demo observation; assert the namespaces and visible records remain isolated
fresh browser context; use /demo; download CSV; assert its header and each of the four sample records
fresh browser context; use /demo; download PDF; assert a non-empty PDF with one page marker
fresh browser context; use /demo; download JSON; assert schema version and all four sample records

claim: There are no analytics, ads, runtime CDNs, or third-party scripts
sandbox: fresh browser context; capture every request during the /demo flow; assert every URL is same-origin

claim: Core capture and exports are free; Brief Plus costs $9 once
where: landing plain facts, Brief Plus section, README, terms
sandbox: fresh browser context; use /demo; assert the $9 one-time price and checkout path are visible

claim: Records date, time, symptom, severity, duration, context, and an optional photo
sandbox: fresh browser context; use /demo; save an observation with every field and a PNG photo; reload and assert the saved timeline details and photo

claim: Filters the chronological timeline by dates or text
sandbox: fresh browser context; use /demo; filter the shipped observations once by context text and once by an inclusive date range

claim: Merging a backup keeps current history and uses newer edits
sandbox: fresh browser context; use /demo; import an older copy of a sample then a newer copy; assert the old copy does not replace it, the newer copy does, and another current sample remains

claim: Brief Plus saves reusable symptom presets and a personalized brief heading
sandbox: fresh browser context; use /demo with a mocked valid license; save a preset and heading, reload, and assert both remain usable

claim: Brief Plus verification sends only the license token and caches its result for a day
sandbox: fresh browser context; use /demo with a mocked valid license; record verification requests, assert its GET contains only the license token, then reload and assert the cached daily verdict avoids another request
